bayts.text: Bless and grant peace, O You Who grant mercy, upon him who is named Prophet of mercy,
his Family and his emigrant Companions (Muhājirūn); and grant me to be the joy of the grateful.
Bless a man of worth whose bosom You have illumined, granting him peace: he is the Prophet of repentance,
the Family and the Companions, again and again, O Giver of success and secrets.
Bless him whose name is Ḥarīṣ (Solicitous), before "for you" (Qurʾān 9:128): its reverse is the greedy one.
granting him peace, and his Family and the Companions; and through me guide to the middle of the clear road.
Pour a blessing accompanied by peace upon him whose name is Maʿlūm (the Known),
his Family and his Companions; and convey my composition to him, pure, that it may reach him.
O You to Whom belong the days and the months, bless him whose name is Shahīr (the Renowned),
and grant him peace with the noble Family and his Companions, O You Whose goods are sought.
O Everlasting, Whose being for me I behold, bless a man of worth whose name is Shāhid (the Witness),
his Family and his illustrious Companions, with the most beneficial honour and peace.
O You to Whom belong the spreading (of the earth) and the levelling, bless him whose name is Shahīd (the Witness),
the Family and the Companions of harmony; and grant peace and make my horizons secure.
O You Whose angels are witnesses, bless him whose name is Mashhūd (the Witnessed),
his Family and his Companions, and grant peace; and by my writing expand the breast of whoever learns.
To You I have turned in sincere repentance (Qurʾān 66:8): make my tongue eloquent in good pleasure.
O You to Whom belong beauty and the giving of glad tidings, bless him whose name is Bashīr (Bearer of good news),
his Family and his Companions, and grant peace; and by his rank make my pen (the instrument of) Your good pleasure.
O You from Whom glad tidings come to me, bless him whose name is Mubashshar (the Recipient of glad tidings),
his Family and his Companions, with peace; and through him make my speech the best of speech.
O You to Whom I have made vows, bless him whose name is Nadhīr (the Warner),
his Family and his Companions, and grant peace; and make my works the joy of the learned.
O Protector, Who through me warns Your enemies, bless the Effacer, whose name is Mundhir (the Admonisher),
his Family and his Companions, and grant peace, O You Who protected me, removing (any chance) that I be wronged.
O You through Whom my heart is illumined, bless a full moon whose name is Nūr (Light),
the Family and the Companions, and grant peace for ever, O You Who turn grief toward others than me.
O You Who guard all of me from gradual luring into ruin, bless with peace the Lamp (Sirāj),
his Family and his Companions; and gladden with this composition the best of mankind.
O You from Whom gain reaches me fulfilled, bless him whose name is Miṣbāḥ (the Lantern),
the Family and the Companions, and grant peace; and grant me to be the joy of every glorious one.
O You Whose Book is guidance for the God-fearing (Qurʾān 2:2), bless a guide whose name is Hudā (Guidance),
the Family and the Companions, and grant peace for ever; and through me gladden whoever has devoted himself to worship.
Bless with Your peace, O Strong (Al-Qawiyy), him whose name is Mahdiyy (the Rightly Guided),
his Family with the chosen Companions; and gladden through me the Ten who were given glad tidings (of Paradise).
O You through Whom my whole being is illumined, bless him whose name is Munīr (the Illuminating),
his Family and his Companions, and grant peace; and by my works expand the breasts of the learned.
Bless and grant peace, O Answerer of the caller, upon him whom You named Dāʿī (the Caller),
his Family with the perfect Companions; and accept with thanks my creed and accept my deeds.
O You through Whom no enemy has headed toward me, bless him whose name is Madʿuww (the Called),
the Family and the Companions, people of election, with peace and a chosen security.
O You through Whom the wondrous comes to me, bless him whose name is Mujīb (the Responder),
his Family and his Companions, and grant peace; and by my works dispel the doubts of the learned.
O You through Whom the noble have yielded to me, bless him whose name is Mujāb (the Answered),
his Family and his Companions, with peace; and by my works erase hardship and blame.
And bless and grant peace, O Living (Al-Ḥayy), upon a noble one whose name is Ḥafiyy (the Solicitous),
the Family and the Companions of generosity; and make my ease everlasting together with plenty.
O You through Whom no enemy has headed toward me, bless him whose name is ʿAfuww (the Pardoning),
the Family and the Companions, objects of care, O You through Whom no crime has headed toward me.
And grant him peace, accept my gratitude and protect me from what draws cunning.
O You through Whom what is pleasing yields to me, bless him whose name is Waliyy (the Friend of God),
granting him peace with the noble Family and the Companions, and guard my joys from being cut off.
And bless and grant peace, O Strong (Al-Qawiyy), upon him whose name is Ḥaqq (Truth), Qawiyy (Strong),
the Family and the Companions of valour in battle, O You Who guard all of me from foes.
O You through Whom security heads toward me, bless him whose name is Amīn (the Trustworthy),
and grant him peace with (his) party, and make my books an unveiling that shows hidden things without reproach.
O You through Whom conjecture has left me, bless him whose name is Maʾmūn (the Trusted),
the Family and the Companions, and grant peace; and through him make my pen an opening of hidden things.
Bless and grant peace, O Merciful One, upon him whose name is Karīm (the Noble),
the Family and the Companions, people of patience, O You Who free from pain and (harsh) endurance.
